_doc: Warrior first-job skills (book 100, job 100): Power Strike, Slash Blast, Iron Body and the passives Improved HP Recovery and Improved MaxHP Increase (spec #151 ticket #163; the owner dropped Endure 1000002 after the spec, so it has no entry, cards or sound). Entry format and tier rules: see ../skills.json _doc. New keys here: action "weapon" (the cast stance is the held weapon's first basic-attack stance, WeaponInfo.skill_action, so a spear stabs and a polearm swings; tier C: the WZ nodes have no action); cast rules weapon_reach (the nearest mob inside the held weapon's swing envelope, BasicAttack.envelope; tier A reach, the same as the basic attack) and range_around (up to mobCount mobs whose body centre is within the canonical level's `range` px of the player; tier A numbers); regen {pool, field} (Loadout.regen_bonus reads the canonical level field instead of a level formula). hpCon is read from the canonical level as hp_cost. Prerequisites in the WZ req nodes are ignored (tier C owner choice #31). cooldown and action_time are tier C (ours).

power_strike.name: Power Strike
power_strike.desc: Deals a killer blow to the nearest monster within your weapon's reach.

text.desc: Use MP to deliver a killer blow to a monster within your weapon's reach.

power_strike._survivor: Tier A: canonical damage %, mpCon, 20 levels, effect/hit art and sound, attackCount 1. Tier C: the WZ node names no weapon (the String text says a sword), so the Warrior melee families (sword, axe, blunt, spear, polearm; v83-facts section 2) can use it; auto-cast on the nearest mob inside the held weapon's swing envelope (the basic attack's reach), 1 s cooldown, stance of the weapon's first basic-attack action held 0.6 s; extra targets only from cards.

slash_blast.name: Slash Blast
slash_blast.desc: Spends HP and MP to strike every monster around you.

text.desc: Use HP and MP to attack the monsters around you.
text.h: HP -{hp_cost}, MP -{mp_cost}; damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters} within {range} px

slash_blast._survivor: Tier A: canonical damage %, hpCon, mpCon, range (130 to 150), mobCount 6, 20 levels, effect/hit art and sound. Tier C: the same Warrior melee weapon families as Power Strike; auto-cast when a monster is within range of the player's body, never when the HP cost would leave 0 HP, 1.6 s cooldown, stance of the weapon's first basic-attack action held 0.6 s; extra targets and a wider range only from cards.

iron_body.name: Iron Body
iron_body._buff: Tier A: canonical pdd, time, mpCon, the alert2 action and sound; the node has no effect art. Tier C: self-only auto-cast while inactive and affordable, recast on expiry; canonical effects snapshot until expiry; 0.8 s cast hold.

improved_hp_recovery.name: Improved HP Recovery
improved_hp_recovery.desc: Recovers additional HP with every regeneration pulse.
improved_hp_recovery._regen: Tier A: canonical hp per level (3 to 50) added to each regeneration pulse. Tier C: v83 applies it only while standing still; here HP regeneration always runs (balance.json regen), so the bonus does too.

improved_max_hp.name: Improved MaxHP Increase
improved_max_hp.desc: Increases the Max HP gained at each level-up.

text.desc: Boosts the Max HP you gain at each level-up.
text.h: Each level-up gives +{x} more Max HP

improved_max_hp._passive: Tier B: Cosmic adds the canonical x (4 to 40) to the Max HP of each level-up at the skill's level then; never retroactive. The AP half of the skill (y per HP AP) has no meaning here (AP is automatic).

threaten.name: Threaten
threaten.desc: Threatens up to six monsters around you, lowering their weapon attack and weapon defence for a while.

text.desc: Use MP to threaten the monsters around you, lowering their weapon attack and weapon defence.
text.h: MP -{mp_cost}; enemy weapon attack {x}, weapon def. {y} for {time} sec., up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}

threaten._cast: Tier A: canonical x (weapon attack change) and y (weapon defence change), both negative and flat, time, mpCon, mobCount 6, lt/rb, the alert2 action, effect art, mob overlay and sound; the node has no prop, so every target takes it (no success roll, no RNG). Tier C: auto-cast through the crowd rule (cast.status threatened) at three eligible mobs that are not threatened yet, 1 s cooldown, nearest targets first; bosses and kinds that resist statuses never take it; it refreshes without stacking and coexists with slow, poison and freeze; mob weapon attack (contact and attack stances) and weapon defence floor at 0, magic attack and magic defence are untouched.
